title: The Late Verdict
author: Ansel Coldharbour
blurb: Marguerite Sandoval, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, has spent three years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
